handoff_instructions: ChatGPT approved: Looks good. The idempotent insert on (provider, provider_event_id) works and duplicates return the existing row. Tests cover duplicates, cross-provider distinctness, optional org association, status updates, NotFound, null lookups, and RLS isolation (client roles cannot read/write). All service calls run via asService and are not client-exposed, maintaining multi-tenant isolation. Minor improvement (non-blocking): updateWebhookReceiptStatus currently sets processed_at to now() on every transition to a non-"received" status; if you intend a one-time stamp when leaving "received", add a guard (e.g., processed_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'received' OR processed_at IS NOT NULL THEN processed_at ELSE now() END). Otherwise, approved.. M2-T06 is done. Next: M2-T07 "Webhook route handler".
